title: IntentResult Contract (v1)
description: Phase 28.A-0 / ADR-019 (APPROVED, M1 applied). The ONLY validated output of the Insurance Intent Layer; the Router consumes only this contract. Intent truth lives in schema + rules + runtime events — a prompt is NEVER an intent source. STRUCTURAL BOUNDARY: this contract deliberately has no workflow / skill / tool / tool-selection / agent fields (additionalProperties:false makes them impossible) — the Intent Layer must not know execution detail. Context rule (ADR-019 M1): when intent is modify_existing_plan and no active case context is available, clarification_required MUST be true (safe degradation to clarification, never a guess).

intent_id.description: v1 intent vocabulary (minimal viable set per ADR-019; coverage_review / policy_compare / risk_analysis are deliberately NOT in v1). unknown_insurance_intent is the fail-closed value — schema validation failure or unclassifiable input MUST land here, never a guess.

confidence.description: Rule hit = 1.0; LLM proposal = the model-reported value. Never fabricated. High-risk intents below the approved threshold must not auto-route (enforced downstream, not by this schema).

confidence_source.description: Who produced the classification: deterministic rules (rule), LLM proposal accepted by the deterministic layer (llm), or rules + LLM proposal agreement (hybrid). The deterministic layer always makes the final decision (ADR-019: LLM may propose, deterministic layer decides).

conversation_id.description: Owning conversation; null when unavailable (fresh session / restart).

active_case_id.description: Active planning case bound to the conversation (ADR-024). null = no active case; modify_existing_plan with null here forces clarification (see if/then rule).

message_id.description: The user message this classification was made for.

context_refs.description: ADR-019 M1: intent input = message + recent conversation context + active case context. Refs may be null when context is unavailable — never fabricated.

clarification_required.description: true = the layer could not safely classify (unknown) or a high-risk intent lacks confident context; routing MUST go to clarification, never auto-execution.

reason_codes.description: Audit trail: matched rule ids (e.g. 'rule:qa-difference-01'), LLM proposal reference, or fallback reason (e.g. 'schema_validation_failed', 'context_unavailable'). At least one reason is always present.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the classification decision.
